templates.subject: Thank you for reaching out to Bloom Family Law
templates.body:
Thank you for reaching out to Bloom Family Law!

To get started, please use this link to schedule a consultation with [Attorney Name]: [Scheduling Link]

You can select your preferred format (Zoom or phone) when booking.

[Attorney Bio]

If you decide to move forward with us after your consultation, you don't need to worry about a large upfront retainer—we work on an hourly basis, so you only pay for the time we actually spend on your matter.

We look forward to hearing more about your situation and discussing how we can help you move forward. Please reach out if you have any questions in the meantime.

Kind regards,

templates.name: Welcome / What to Expect (New Client)
templates.subject: Welcome to Bloom Family Law — Next Steps
templates.body:
Dear [Client First Name],

We are excited to collaborate with you and assist with your case. Here's what we need to get started. 

Please review the two emails we just sent to you. Once you review and sign, we can get started. 

Here's what's coming next:

1. MyCase is our case management software. You will receive an email from them with a secure link to your Fee Agreement. Please review, then click the box above your name on the last page to sign. Once your attorney countersigns the agreement, you will receive a fully executed copy.
2. LawPay, our secure payment processor, will also email you to set up your payment account. Most of our clients prefer the eCheck option to avoid the 3% processing fee for debit/credit card payments.

Please check your Spam folder if you do not see these links, and always feel free to reach out with any questions.

We look forward to working with you.

[Signature]
